title: KLANDESTINE FIELD MANUAL
subtitle: Master the shadows. Know the rules. Dominate the battlefield.

content.objective: Reduce your opponent's health to 0 to win the game!
content.overview: Kloak & Daggurrs: Klandestine is a game of strategic card combat with hidden allegiances, mana management, and type-based advantages. Each player builds a deck around their chosen faction's vigor type and battle for supremacy.

steps: Draw 7 cards to start the game.
Determine who goes first (highest roll or coin flip).
content.deckBuilding: A deck needs exactly 60 cards. You can have up to 4 copies of the same card. Build your deck around your mana type for synergies, or mix types for versatility!

content.overview: Each turn consists of three phases:

phases.name: 1. Draw Phase
phases.description: Draw 1 card from your deck. If your deck is empty, shuffle your discard pile.

phases.name: 2. Action Phase
phases.description: Play cards, use abilities, and attack. Cards can be:
options: Played face-down: Placed as a 'Kloak' — a hidden trap or bluff.

phases.name: 3. End Phase
phases.description: Max hand size is 7. Discard down if needed. Pass turn clockwise.

content.overview: Mana is your resource for playing cards and activating abilities.
rules: Play Mana cards to increase generation (+1 per card).
Each card has a mana cost shown in the top corner.
Plan your turns to use as much mana as possible.
Save big creatures for when you have enough mana.

content.overview: There are 14 Vigor types, each with strengths and weaknesses. Mastering these matchups is key to victory!
content.advantageRules: Attacking with a type advantage deals 1.5x damage! Attacking a type you're weak to deals only 0.5x damage. Learn the matchups to dominate!

content.overview: Cards come in different types with different purposes:

cardTypes.name: Vigor Cards
cardTypes.description: Mana generators and resource cards. Play these to build your mana pool and set up your strategy.

cardTypes.name: Creature Cards
cardTypes.description: Your main attackers and defenders. Each has Attack Power (AP) and Defense Power (DP). Creatures can't attack the turn they're played.

cardTypes.name: Accoutrements
cardTypes.description: Equipment and items that boost your creatures or provide special abilities.

cardTypes.name: Runes
cardTypes.description: Instant spells and effects that can turn the tide of battle at critical moments.

cardTypes.name: Primordial Beings
cardTypes.description: Legendary creatures with immense power. Devastating when played correctly.

content.rarity: Cards come in different rarities: Thrall (Common), Skilled (Uncommon), Karls (Rare), Jarl (Mythic), and Konugr (Legendary). Higher rarity cards have more powerful effects.

content.overview: When a player attacks another, the defender may flip a face-down Kloak card. The Kloak's hidden effect resolves immediately — this could block the attack, redirect it, or trigger a trap.
combatRules: Select your creature to attack with
Choose a target (enemy creature or opponent directly)
Damage is calculated with mana type multipliers
If no enemy creatures exist, attack goes directly to opponent's health

cardStats.ap: Attack Power (AP) - Damage dealt when attacking. Higher AP means more damage to enemies.
cardStats.dp: Defense Power (DP) - Your creature's health. When DP reaches 0, the creature is destroyed.

resolvingKloaks: Defender chooses to flip 0, 1, or 2 Kloaks.
Kloak effects resolve in order played.
If attack still valid, damage is dealt.
content.bluffing: You can play any card face-down as a Kloak — even a Common. The threat is often more powerful than the card itself.

content.overview: Choose your allegiance wisely. Each faction has unique abilities and focuses on specific vigor types.

factions.name: Ash Cycle
factions.description: Masters of deception and chaos tactics.

factions.name: Crimson Oath
factions.description: Relentless pursuers of power and wealth.

factions.name: Etched Power
factions.description: Defenders of the land and stability.

factions.name: Eternal Reach
factions.description: Guardians of the ethereal and ancient wisdom.

factions.name: First Light
factions.description: Harbingers of dawn and celestial power.

factions.name: Golden Flow
factions.description: Navigators of tides and emotional currents.

factions.name: Hidden Truth
factions.description: Keepers of secrets and lunar mysteries.

factions.name: Hollow End
factions.description: Embracers of decay and regrowth cycles.

content.overview: K&D cards are designed to be modular. Use them as:

uses.name: Magic: The Gathering — Commander Tokens
uses.description: Gold cards make excellent custom commander representations. Their faction abilities map well to commander color identities.

uses.name: D&D — Spell Cards & NPC Factions
uses.description: Use the eight factions as rival guilds in your campaign. Card effects translate directly to encounter abilities.

uses.name: Board Games — Event Deck
uses.description: Shuffle K&D cards into any game's event deck. The rarity system balances randomness.

uses.name: Custom Formats
uses.description: Build your own formats. Some community favorites:
formats: Kloak Only: All cards played face-down. Pure bluffing.
Faction Wars: Players openly play their faction. No secrets.
Solitaire: Survive 20 turns against an automated 'Shadow' deck.
